blocks.text: Internet aur digital auzaar taleem ke liye roz ba roz zaroori hain. COVID-19 ki waba mein jab Pakistan aur doosri jagah school online hue, kam aamdani ya dehi ilaqon ke students internet ya aalaat ke baghair mushkil mein pare, aur groups ke darmiyan taleemi faasla barha.

blocks.prompt: Digital divide taleem par kaise asar dalta hai (MCQ 5)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Digital taleemi wasail tak rasai mein na-barabari paida karta hai.

items: Taleemi na-barabari: baghair aalaat ya internet ke students peeche reh jate hain (COVID-19 online classes).
